messages:
mia: Noticed a bad one during Private onboarding: when sampleapp runs with LOG_LEVEL=debug it logs headers raw and we ended up printing X-Api-Key. Repro: spin the latest sampleapp image and hit /setup.
rahul: omg. can u paste the exact payload?
mia: ```DEBUG sampleapp request_id=req-9f8a headers={"Host":"private.local", "X-Api-Key":"sk_test_9abCDefGhijKlmnOP", "User-Agent":"sampleapp/1.2"} body={...}```
sara: looks like our sanitizer only targets Authorization and a few variants. we didn't normalize header names before matching so X-Api-Key slipped through. also the logging path constructs the headers string before otel sanitizers run.
tony: short-term patch: 1) in logging helper, lowercase header names and run sanitizer immediately, 2) add pattern for x-.*key and x-api-key to secret regexes. long-term: move sanitization into the earliest telemetry middleware so nothing sensitive reaches any formatter.
ops-jen: note for Dedicated: LB strips some headers, but Private customers run locally so app-level is required. also we should push a security advisory to onboarding docs.
rahul: agree. also add unit test that starts sampleapp with LOG_LEVEL=debug and asserts logs don't contain token patterns (regex: `sk_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}` and `(?i)x-.*key`).
mia: draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/2399 — it lowercases headers and runs sanitize_header_values() early. needs review + tests.
sara: grabbing it. I'll add an e2e that runs container for 5s and greps logs. Also ensure audit/export logs (S3/zip) are sanitized.
rahul: small caveat: make sure we only redact header VALUES that match secret shapes, not request_id values. we must not wipe correlation ids. Add a whitelist of header names allowed to keep raw values for tracing.
tony: good call. implement value-level regex + list of protected header-names. and add a changelog entry so customers know debug may filter sensitive headers now.
devex-bot: created issue #4622: sampleapp-debug-header-leak, linked PR 2399.
mia: I'll add CI job that runs the smoke test on every push to catch regressions. planning to cut a patch image and update onboarding guide once merged.
ops-jen: I'll add a short blurb to Dedicated onboarding about LB masking to reduce confusion.
sara: one more ask: product/docs should advise devs to use LOG_LEVEL=info by default in Private unless actively troubleshooting. add to the quickstart.
rahul: thanks. after merge let's run a quick pass across other SDKs to ensure parity in sanitization behavior.
